requirements: Record session/connection/permission/model/execution/report/evidence exceptions, original observations, uncertainty, selected recovery and verified outcome.
Every supervisor judgment and choice retains goal revision, evidence, real alternatives, concise reason, expected outcome and actual result; do not record hidden chain of thought.
User review can append a correction or clarification linked to the original immutable decision; preserve original versions and show downstream effects.
Corrections fence affected pending directives and judgments; completed actions remain historical facts and corrective work receives a new explicit instruction.
Reuse experiences only with matching prerequisites, version/context, authority and evidence; record which experience influenced a new decision and why.
Experience candidates have validation, counterexample, retirement and revalidation states; unverified candidates never become automatic Skills or unconditional rules.
Provide concise review-needed cards and expandable decision/outcome timelines, with real owner-authorized correction controls and CAS/idempotency.
Verify changed judgments with side-effect-free recorded-case replay and subsequent actual outcomes, distinguishing simulation from live execution.
